name: Four Seasons London at Park Lane
positioning: Luxury hotel in Mayfair, opposite Hyde Park Corner, with a Michelin-starred restaurant and a rooftop Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Mayfair base close to Hyde Park
Families who want complimentary dining at Pavyllon London for children up to 5 years old

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Mayfair.
The hotel is directly opposite Hyde Park Corner.
Buckingham Palace is approximately 1 kilometre (0.6 miles) from the hotel.
The Spa has nine treatment rooms.
The Spa is on the 10th floor.
The hotel is pet friendly, welcoming one dog per room.

highlights.text: Pavyllon London is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Mayfair.
Pavyllon London has counter seating overlooking a dynamic open kitchen.
Bar Antoine is Chef Yannick Alléno's first-ever bar concept.
The Sky Suite at the Spa has 180° views of Hyde Park and the London skyline.
The Spa has two skylit vitality pools.
Complimentary dining at Pavyllon London is offered for children up to 5 years old.

considerations.text: The Vitality Pool is adults only.
Guests who expect to arrive early and want immediate access to their room are advised to book the room for the prior night.
Golf is an off-site activity, 45 minutes away.
WhataHotel notes the busy Mayfair location may have street noise.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
